name: dsh-lan-proxy
description: DSH web plugin: LAN reverse proxy for the DSH web UI (default 0.0.0.0:15151 -> 127.0.0.1:3080, Host/Origin rewritten to loopback, crypto.randomUUID polyfill injected). Settings namespace dsh-lan-proxy: enabled (default false), host, port, authEnabled, authUser, authPass. Ships a client half: editable config card in the settings Plugins page (client/client.js, built by client/build.mjs).
